descriptions.text: Enchanted crupper. The Crupper of the Benevolent Champion. This is a unique item. This item is part of a matched set with the Cloak of the Benevolent Champion. There are two more pieces to this set. Find the third, and the fourth will be awarded in a box. Considering what you did to get this one, it's gotta be something really good. This item was originally awarded in a celestial slap-chop box during the 9th floor. Let's talk about what a hero is. You, Donut, received this prize because you performed one of the most brutal kills in the history of this game. …

recap.text: Donut's War Crime spell earns her two celestial boxes, and the slap-chop one flutters out as a golden blanket, folds into an origami swan and opens on a silver chain-mail crupper. Mordecai swears at it before it vanishes. She swaps her Fae-Scale Crupper, worn since the first floor for a laughable +2 dexterity, for the Crupper of the Benevolent Champion. Its description, about the gnoll quartermaster Sanderson Pinkstaff she killed, forces her to raise Puddle Jumper to level 16.

beats.headline: A golden blanket, a swan
beats.text: Donut's War Crime spell earned her two celestial boxes. The slap-chop box is a quivering golden blanket that flutters through the room like a magic carpet, dances about, folds into an origami swan and opens on a plain silver crupper, like the one she already wears but made of fine chain mail instead of larger scales. Holy fucking shit, says Mordecai, before it disappears. He has not seen its abilities yet, but it matches her champion cloak. It is called the Crupper of the Benevolent Champion.
beats.gist: A golden blanket box folds into a swan and opens on Donut's silver crupper.

beats.headline: A matched set, and a rant
beats.text: Off comes the Enchanted Fae-Scale Quadruped Crupper of the Fleet, worn since the first floor for a +2 dexterity that is laughable now, and on goes the new one: lighter, more elegant, with an opalescent glow. An achievement for a matched set says a third piece earns a fourth. Then Donut reads the description and goes stiff. It is about Sanderson Pinkstaff, a gnoll quartermaster she killed in her attack, and his children, and whether a hero can be a hero to all. It makes her raise one spell to level 16 now. She picks Puddle Jumper.
beats.gist: Donut replaces her old Crupper with a lighter, opalescent one whose description names Sanderson Pinkstaff, whom she killed.
